issues.description: The template's example usage in Main.java shows animal constructors with two parameters (e.g., Seal("Clarabelle", "marine")), while the problem UML and the solution implement Animal and concrete animals with a single-parameter constructor (name only). This discrepancy can confuse students about the required constructor signature for Animal and its subclasses and may lead them to implement incorrect constructors.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the template example with the UML and solution: update the commented example constructors in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Main.java to use single-argument constructors (e.g., Seal("Clarabelle"), Pig("Doodle"), Goat("Buttinsky")). Alternatively, if a two-argument constructor was intended, update the problem statement UML and the solution to include the additional attribute and corresponding constructor parameter.
